new_rule_properties: Balanced, typed, nested and repeated ASCII/fullwidth parenthetical qualifiers are parsed structurally; no ordinal phrase, qualifier length, company identity or page-ID condition.

Only an outer-level announcement marker can terminate the main title. An unclosed or mismatched prefix cannot be repaired by a marker inside it. Bare announcement titles and symbol-only nonempty qualifiers are accepted.

Complete source Word provenance is required, including punctuation. Punctuation-only Word fonts do not override content typography; content uses source font/size identity sets without a font-name list.

A heading starts semantic scope only at a completely source-owned closed frame, a vertical heading/body topology, or a horizontal local block with typography/writing-axis contrast. Prose references cannot fence solely because they contain an announcement word.
Independent but unparsed or style-ambiguous headings fence publication evidence, so another announcement cannot borrow their date/signature.

A complete independent frame can use an arbitrary whole-line title even when its formal suffix is unparsed or its font continues the preceding unrelated document. Its own distinct date style, own signature and child fences are still required.
An independently dated financial frame may use its complete statement table as a terminal witness; related financial statements stay in their common procedure frame.

All old Run bytes/styles/whole tables and old Article endpoints remain protected by existing source-offset partitioning; source emission reversal and native-font bijection are tested on seven real PDFs.
new_domain_vocabulary: No new company/name/page/ordinal vocabulary. Existing announcement suffix, financial category, date syntax and six signature role prefixes remain domain vocabulary.
